goal.title: Cave Statistics, Quantitative Telemetry & Token Savings
goal.intent: Implement deterministic cave statistics engine reporting temporal extents, DAG message totals, structural elements, disk footprints, and token savings across CLI (ccrystal stats) and MCP (crystal_stats)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Define CaveStats and TokenSavings domain models and codecs in core
Implement CaveStatsEngine in core measuring temporal extents, structural elements, and disk metrics
Implement token estimation and savings algorithm (comparing raw transcript re-ingestion vs selective hydration and melting)
Implement Decline parser for ccrystal stats in cli (--json, --include-archived, --detailed)
Implement ccrystal stats execution and dashboard rendering in Runner
Expose crystal_stats in DefaultMcpHandler tools/list and wire execution
Write unit and end-to-end integration tests across core and cli modules
Export MCP schema crystal_stats.json and update Agent Skill and documentation
Run full multi-platform verification and compile optimized native release binary

nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'cave-stats-and-telemetry' with goal: Cave Statistics, Quantitative Telemetry & Token Savings
Cave statistics, storage metrics, and quantitative token savings engine implemented across CLI (ccrystal stats) and MCP (crystal_stats) with full multi-platform test coverage.
